evidence: WordPress security plugin; REST extended-protection mutations require Capabilities::can_manage_plugin(). Manager installs a packaged firewall bootstrap and config, writes an owned .htaccess/.user.ini block, checks activation, and removes/restores the owned startup changes on uninstall.

Manager.php and Bootstrap.php are byte-identical to 2.0.0. The bootstrap reads local WAF config, loads local rules, evaluates request/IP policy and emits block responses; no request-to-shell execution path was found.
All 22 changed JavaScript files are byte-identical after replacing ?ver=2.0.0 with ?ver=2.0.1 in the older files; these are local module cache-busting references.

Console commands pass HMAC/replay verification through RequestVerifier and an explicit operation allowlist. No new command-execution channel was added in this release.
